description: This HTML file defines the front-end interface for a Database Viewer web application, including layout, styling, and client-side JavaScript logic for interacting with backend API endpoints to list databases, tables, and display table data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from API and renders them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands/collapses cell content to show full data.
